context: A retired CEO mentors a younger boss over coffee
purpose: Teach: 引き下げ/免除/落札/需給/補完/著名/完結/出入り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君の会社、最近価格引き下げに踏み切ったそうだね。需給バランスを見ての判断かい？
lines.en: I heard your company recently went through with a price cut. Was it a decision based on supply and demand?
lines.style: Calm elderly mentor voice, gentle probing tone, measured pace

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、在庫が積み上がってきまして、利益を還元する形で値段を下げました。
lines.en: Yes, inventory had been piling up, so we lowered prices as a way to return value to our customers.
lines.style: Polite middle-aged executive, respectful and slightly tense tone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: なるほど。ただ、入札で落札した大型案件の利益に頼りすぎるのは危ういよ。
lines.en: I see. But relying too much on the profits from large contracts you win through bidding is risky.
lines.style: Reflective senior tone, warning wrapped in warmth and experience

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。だからこそ、他社と相互に補完できる関係を急いで築いております。
lines.en: Exactly as you say. That's why we're rushing to build mutually complementary relationships with other firms.
lines.style: Earnest younger boss, deferential and forward-leaning delivery

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 賢明だ。それと、新興国向けの関税の免除がいつまで続くかも読みにくい時代だからね。
lines.en: Wise. And it's hard to predict how long the tariff exemptions for emerging markets will last in these times.
lines.style: Sage advisor adding caveat, soft and authoritative voice

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。一つの優遇に頼る経営の危うさ、恥ずかしながら軽く見ておりました。
lines.en: I'll keep that engraved in my heart. I'm ashamed to admit I underestimated the risk of leaning on a single preferential treatment.
lines.style: Humbled boss accepting wisdom, voice slightly lowered and reflective

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それから、業界で著名な経営者ほど、社員の出入りに細やかに気を配っているものだよ。
lines.en: Also, the more renowned an executive in the industry, the more attentively they pay attention to employee turnover.
lines.style: Sage advisor delivering aphorism, soft and authoritative cadence

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 確かに、人の流れを軽く見ていた自分が情けないです。明日から見直してまいります。
lines.en: Indeed, I feel pathetic for having taken the flow of people lightly. I'll start reviewing it from tomorrow.
lines.style: Humbled boss with resolve, slightly lowered then firming voice

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いやいや、君の経営者としての物語はまだ完結していない。これからが本番さ。
lines.en: No, no, your story as an executive hasn't reached its conclusion yet. The real game starts from here.
lines.style: Encouraging chuckle from elder, warm closing reassurance and lift

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。また定期的にご指導いただけますでしょうか。
lines.en: Thank you very much. May I continue to receive your guidance regularly?
lines.style: Grateful sincere request, slight bow conveyed in respectful voice
